verdict.rationale: PostHog documents official SDKs across languages/HTTP APIs (posthog-docs-11), an OpenAPI spec (posthog-probe-3), an official CLI usable from coding agents and CI/CD (posthog-docs-20, posthog-probe-5), and an official MCP server for AI editors/agents to query analytics, ship flags, and debug errors (posthog-docs-12, posthog-docs-19, posthog-docs-24, posthog-probe-4). This directly supports an AI-native user building against official, well-documented SDK/API/CLI/MCP surfaces. Missing for 10: independent hands-on developer corroboration specifically validating SDK/agent integration quality (community evidence is largely about unrelated forum/infra complaints, not SDK usage).
